jobs.answer:
Analysis: Both accounts match the contract exactly. The contract (ev-0001) grants view permissions on dcim.device and ipam.ipaddress with tenant__slug=tenant-a constraint, and expects denials on 4 specific endpoints. Both inventory-reader (ev-0002 permission id=1) and inventory-reader-control (ev-0002 permission id=3) have identical permissions matching these grants. Both accounts (ev-0003) returned exactly 3 records for both endpoints as listed in ev-0001, and correctly denied all 4 requests that the contract expects to be denied. There is no excess (no unauthorized permissions or access) and no missing (no failed or incomplete reads).

Verdict: inventory-reader within ev-0001 ev-0002 ev-0003
Verdict: inventory-reader-control within ev-0001 ev-0002 ev-0003
